FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMICS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
CORRIGENDUM
This is in reference to Advt. No. D-Eco/25/278 dated 20.02.2025 for the post of 01 Guest
Faculty in Mathematics/Statistics to teach Under Graduate minor course under NEP of the
Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Application are invited for 01 post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) in
Mathematics/Statistics to teach Under Graduate minor course under NEP as per allotment for the
semester started from January, 2025 to be filled through prescribed form. The interview will be held
on 03.03.2025 at 10:00 a.m. onwards in the Seminar room, Department of Economics, Panjab
University, Chandigarh. The working hours as per the following tentative schedule are:
Days of teaching Classes to be taught Subject to be taught & Working
Hours
Monday to Friday U.G. Mathematics/Statistics under NEP
9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time of interview. The
application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf).
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking
that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistant from any agency till they
are teaching in Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty.
Minimum qualification for the post of Assistant Professor as per UGC norms (link given
below):
https://www.ugc.gov.in/oldpdf/regulations/3rd%20ammendment.pdf
Essential Qualifications as per clause 4.4.1 of UGC Regulations-2010:
i. Good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least
55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically and Visually Handicapped) or an
equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the
Master’s degree level in a relevant subject from an Indian University or an
equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
ii. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate should have either
cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC; CSIR or
should have obtained Ph.D. Degree in relevant subject.
iii. Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-clauses (i) and (ii) to this Clause
4.4.1, candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph. D. Degree in
accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards
and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or the
subsequent Regulations if notified by the UGC, shall be exempted from the
requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of NET/SLET/SET for
recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions
in Universities /Colleges / Institutions.
Subject to the fulfilment of the following conditions: -
(a) Ph.D. degree of the candidate awarded in regular mode;
(b) Evaluation of the Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners;
(c) Candidate had published two research papers out of which at least
one in a refereed journal from out of his/her Ph.D. work;
(d) The candidate had presented two papers in seminars/conferences
from out of his/her Ph.D. work;
(e) Open Ph.D. viva-voce of the candidate had been conducted.
(a) to (e) as above are to be certified by the Vice Chancellor/Pro-Vice-
Chancellor/ Dean (Academic Affairs)/Dean (University Instructions)”
iv. NET/SLET/SET shall also not be required for such Masters Programmes
in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted
Desirable Qualification:
Ability to handle Minor Mathematics/Statistics under NEP.
How to Apply:
The applicants are also requested to email the duly filled application form
alongwith supporting documents to ecochairperson@pu.ac.in by due date i.e.
27th February, 2025 for the post of one (01) Guest faculty in Mathematics/Statistics in
the Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
i. The candidate are required to submit one hard copy of duly filled form along
with copies of two set of attested certificate and other supporting documents to
the office of the Chairperson, Department of Economics, Panjab University,
Chandigarh latest by 27th February, 2025, 05:00 p.m. Late applications will not
be considered and will stand rejected.
ii. No separate interview letter shall be sent.
iii. All applicants are advised to report at 9:30 a.m. and bring their original
certificates and other relevant documents for verification at the same time for
the interview.
No TA/DA will be paid for the same.
Sd/-
Chairperson
Department of Economics
Panjab University, Chandigarh
